python -m zonos3.reference --model <dir|hf://...> (--text T | --request req.json) -o out.wav [options]

Synthesizes one v2 GenerateRequest with the plain-PyTorch reference and writes 16-bit mono 44.1 kHz WAV.
``--dump-prompt ids.npy`` writes the prompt rows (float32 [rows, n_codebooks + 1]) and the ``ids.cond.json`` sidecar of
``zonos3-cli --build-prompt``; a CFG twin's rows go to ``ids.twin.npy`` / ``ids.twin.cond.json``. With
``--dump-prompt`` alone nothing is generated.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         LM checkpoint directory or hf:// folder
  --text TEXT
  --request REQUEST     v2 GenerateRequest JSON file
  -o OUT, --out OUT     output WAV
  --device DEVICE
  --dtype {f32,bf16}
  --steer-bundle STEER_BUNDLE
  --accent-adapters ACCENT_ADAPTERS
  --phoneme-rows PHONEME_ROWS
                        zonos-text-extra/1 rows (phoneme / start / pause
                        tokens; a path or hf://) appended at load, after the
                        vocabulary a speech-edit adapter grows (default: the
                        release text rows with the release LM; '' loads none)
  --laci-heads LANG=PATH
  --dump-prompt IDS_NPY
